items.title: Recovering an object of the derived category of a suitable subcategory as the derived limit of its truncations
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that in the situation of the Olsson-Laszlo comparison, every object of the derived category of the subcategory is recovered as the derived limit of its truncations (statement lines 5706-5719, whose annotation block recording the classical sources is a comment-type environment and is delivered as written; the situation fixing the hypotheses is delivered verbatim as a context span from lines 5686-5704). The proof extracts the vanishing bounds supplied by the situation and applies the companion criterion of the same section (proof lines 5721-5723). The content is the matching of the bounds with the criterion. The claim is H2: one application of a companion criterion.
